notes.title: Update log for October 8, 2024
notes.notes:
·Optimized all Japanese texts, we would like to express our sincere thanks to the translator Lpakamos!

Note: Since the email content is bound to the save file, the text of the email you have unlocked will not be updated until you reset the game.

notes.title: Update log for August 8, 2024
notes.notes: ·We have added compatibility support for older GPU and older versions of Windows, so the game can now run better on these computers.

notes.title: Update log for August 5, 2024
notes.notes: ·Fixed some English text (thanks to Orange for his great support).

notes.title: Update log for August 3, 2024
notes.notes:
The little fairy has recently become obsessed with Grimm's Fairy Tales, and the story of Hansel and Grete deeply attracted her. She couldn't help but think as she saw the two children in the story scattering bread crumbs on the ground to guide them through the forest.

Now the little fairy can throw the gold coins, silver coins and copper coins she picked up on the ground again as markers in the maze.

At the same time, we have also made the following adjustments to the maze:

·Reduced the side length of the Hard difficulty maze by 25%.
·Reduced the side length of the Lunatic difficulty maze by 50%.
·Now after passing a high-difficulty maze, you will also get the achievement of a low-difficulty maze.

notes.title: Update on August 2, 2024
notes.notes:
We have released several patches in the past two days to fix some issues in the game.

1. Fixed the problem that the installer version number in the email sent by Lü Dongbin was incorrect (thanks to 侯宇琛nb)

2. Fixed the problem that the delete read mail button does not work (thanks to Ashwall_Penguin)

3. Fixed the problem that caused the GPU to be fully loaded when running the game on some PCs (Thanks to 太田針妙丸)

4. Mr. Hagrid now has his own email account (thanks to null)

5. Fixed the problem of the window size jumping in non-maximized state after returning to the mailbox from the installation wizard (Thanks to Ashwall_Penguin)

6. Fixed the problem of loading conflict when multiple items in the steam workshop have scenes with the same name (Thanks to Qianqian and Likia!)

I would like to express my deep gratitude to the players who helped point out the above issues!

notes.title: "Malware" will be released on August 1
notes.notes:
Dear players

"Malware" will be released early next month (August 1), and we sincerely hope that our game will bring you happiness by then. Stay tuned!

Sincerely, OddGames
